title: The Tales of Alonia: A D&D Vault
description:
This mod adds items from a D&D campaign that I was in, adding main character's weapons, NPCs, fun mechanics, and making you feel as overpowered as a level 20 Steve should feel, with a grind to get to that point.

You can't be overpowered without trying.
body:
This is a D&D inspired modpack from my own personal campaigns that I have played in. I opted to create the player items, the fun NPC encounters, and the sprites themselves, I also added in some other D&D campaigns to really broaden the fun.

Feel as powerful as a level 20 character.

This modpack adds many items from the Forgotten Seas campaign (Part of the Tales of Alonia verse), such as;

- Anos Pepper's "Sage on the Clouds", a melee weapon designed to make you feel like a powerful monk, running and jumping, whilst attacking.
- Kennethson Hegton's "Ace of Spades", a weapon well-known by many fans, it packs a punch and delivers blows, just as it should
- Stephen Andreas-Vargheim's armour, designed to create a sense of power whilst in it, ranking higher than any other, and making you become an unstoppable force in combat.
- Eiwyn The Soldier's broken blade, once used to maintain the peace, now a weapon at your disposal, with the highest damage output, and passives to make you feel like a brick wall, become that same wall she was for her party.

And to achieve all of this, you'll need to beat the boss...

Steel Chair Stevenson! A goliath that deems to destroy any and all with his illustrious steel chairs. Prepare yourself.


You can get a Steel Chair Stevenson spawn egg via Villager trades, where you need to acquire the brand new Ena Coin, 25 gold ingots each to trade for it! Better start grinding those capitalism bones!
